title: Many-to-many relationships
objectives: A junction table identifies one association between two entities. Its primary key must cover the full relationship, or valid memberships will be rejected.
The primary key includes tenant, member and project, and both references carry the same tenant to prevent cross-organization associations.
securityBoundary: A many-to-many table can accumulate duplicate or unauthorized roles if the unique key or permission boundary is missing. Composite foreign keys validate identities, not actor permissions.
